pr_title: Bluetooth: Fix GATT CCC issue with multiple local identities
pr_body:
Fix issue where a new connection with the same peer would use the CCC
from from first connection, despite different local identity.
Since there is no CCC for the new connection yet this caused the
application to think that CCC was enabled but the remote device had not
yet subscribed.
    
Fix this issue by making the id as an input to the peer address check
function. This will force us to make the check every time. This
might also fix similar issues not yes discovered as the ID check was
missing in a few other places as well.

Fixes: #23023
pr_comments: @MarekPieta Can you please check for me?

This sure looks like the first step to have multiple adapter support in Zephyr since it appears this wants to have all states per identity. Btw, I don't think the spec describe this scenario so this might be confusing if we don't have a clear way to describe what is it that we are trying to accomplished, IMO bonding and CCC state shall go along, so we can do CCC state per identity if bonding is per identity, that would bloat the code for single identity though, besides let say someone decides to really do have 2 different controllers so we will have to deal with 2 layer of complexity one stack over another.

@Vudentz The state change is mostly due to this:
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/22949/files#diff-18e9bede72d2870a34b188f8dda195c6R1737 
Which could potentially save the sc_data for the bond with a different identity.

For the rest the state change would not change anything. For the time being most of the places where we use the state lookup it is to find the pending connections. And then there can be only one connection in that specific state. For advertising extension with multiple advertising set that might change. But then there could still be two advertiser using the same identity. So still unsure how that will look.

> This sure looks like the first step to have multiple adapter support in Zephyr since it appears this wants to have all states per identity. Btw, I don't think the spec describe this scenario so this might be confusing if we don't have a clear way to describe what is it that we are trying to accomplished, IMO bonding and CCC state shall go along, so we can do CCC state per identity if bonding is per identity, that would bloat the code for single identity though, besides let say someone decides to really do have 2 different controllers so we will have to deal with 2 layer of complexity one stack over another.

@Vudentz Just to clarify, this is not really trying to start the path towards multiple adapter support in Zephyr. It is instead fixing issues with a feature that has been in Zephyr for a while (multiple identity support), introduced by @jhedberg at the request of Nordic engineers that maintain a Zephyr-based keyboard+mouse application reference design.

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: GATT CCC problem (GATT Server)
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The GATT CCCs are not properly connected with Bluetooth local identities on GATT Server. This may cause problems when using multiple Bluetooth local identities.

**To Reproduce**
Reproduced with `nrf_desktop` application (from NordicPlayground/fw-nrfconnect-nrf):

1. Use Bluetooth Peripheral device with GATT Server, supporting multiple Bluetooth local identities.
2. Bond the device twice with the same host using various Bluetooth local identities.
3. Reboot the device.
4. Observe problems sending GATT notifications after reconnection.

**Impact**
GATT notifications may not be properly sent when using Bluetooth local identities.

**Screenshots or console output**
Peripheral device being unable to send BAS notification, every notification try fails (Peripheral assumes that notifications are not enabled).
```
[59624386] <inf> battery_meas: Battery level: 89% (4068 mV)
[59624388] <inf> event_manager: e: battery_level_event level=89
[59624389] <err> bas: GATT notify failed (err=-57)
```

review_comments: I guess we should initialize it on `gatt_sub_add`
